scope: Exploratory single-source-receiver m1-natural, full three-view PAMF including reference response; source RX 1, days 1/2/3, six identities, seeds 2026092701/02/03, three fixed methods. Main split and leo_weak excluded. Existing target data were exposed in development and do not constitute independent confirmation.
hypothesis: Train unlabeled physical views with partial attenuation of a deployed branch to reduce reliance on one vulnerable path. Compare sample-balanced attenuation with routing based on each source packet's observed raw-to-simulated change. The half-amplitude attenuation is a fixed training perturbation, not a claimed calibrated physical channel model; effectiveness and independent novelty remain unproven.

candidates.mechanism: Cycle assignments equally over time, frequency, PA, signature and reference using packet position and source step; attenuate the same assigned branch in both existing physical U views.
For each certified simulated source packet choose the branch with lowest detached raw-versus-physical cosine similarity and attenuate that branch in both physical U views.
Choose the most and second-most changed branches from the detached physical probe, attenuating one in each of the two existing physical U views.

shared: Continue Tri E20 using the single-source-RX cross-day relation, source branch-certified physical As and existing branch-specific U/L guard. Only the actual accepted-and-certified physical U slots receive an activation factor 0.5 on one deployed path; frequency and PA attenuation cover both corresponding projected terms. Original raw U pseudo-label and mask, unselected slots, L losses, inference graph and model parameters remain unchanged. For every selected batch use two additional eval/no-gradient source-U raw/physical forwards to compute five branch cosine changes, including for the balanced control to match probe cost. Probe sees same-packet source U IQ and no U truth or target data. Hooks are scoped to the two existing training-mode physical U forwards and removed immediately.
initialization: Exact original same-setting and same-seed source-only Tri E20, then fixed own E30 and E50/11100 updates, original fixed time permutation and default head. No external teacher or target-derived initialization.
controls: source-day physical training without branch attenuation
evaluation: Freeze all nine candidate predictions before independent truth-last scoring. Same physical IDs; clean and six practical scenes; DURA-LU primary, DURA-L/raw secondary; report cross-date separately from combined cross-RX/cross-both, each seed and scene, TX/RX/day and paired correction/regression. No target-selected checkpoint, parameter tuning or selective reruns.
success: Seek more than 2 percentage points above ordinary PL on clean and every practical DURA-LU scene and improvement over Tri; retain all seed and subgroup failures. Exposed single-setting results cannot prove all-settings success.
command: python -m experiments.pamf_physics_tri.publish --physical-branch-dropout --repo REPO --output UNIQUE_LOCAL_ROOT --context EXISTING_CONTEXT --ssh-config N607_CONFIG
resources: N607 ordinary non-privileged account, immutable release and run, GPU 0–7, at most four observed/pending processes per GPU including other owners; preserve unrelated healthy jobs.
stop_rule: Systemic technical failure stops new dispatch; preserve all healthy workers and outputs. Each same-seed E20 no-query smoke must execute two source-only probes and route actual certified physical U packets through both existing views; inspect guarded U gradients.
expected_artifacts: Nine source-contract E20 no-query smoke checks
Nine E50 checkpoints with branch routing counters
Nine frozen seven-scene predictions and independent truth-last paired comparisons
